title: Samsung Electronics 2026 second-quarter earnings results
excerpt: Second-quarter revenue was KRW 171.5 trillion, operating profit KRW 89.5 trillion, and common-share EPS KRW 10,849.
summary: Samsung's detailed Q2 results confirm record revenue and operating profit led by AI-server memory, stronger cash and lower debt, while Device eXperience posted an operating loss and management warned of geopolitical and demand uncertainty.
